create.name: Aki Hirata Quetzalyolotzin
create.bio:
Aki Hirata Quetzalyolotzin grew up in Japan and moved to the United States at eighteen. In New York she founded MINKA brooklyn, a collectively run healing centre organised around community and social equity, and she now works from Japan again. She holds master-teacher level in Usui Reiki and, with her long-time teaching partner Manu Del Prete, co-teaches Earth Evolution Reiki, a system the two say reached them through channelled sessions; students know the pair as the Reiki Godmothers. Her training also takes in IET, 13th Octave LaHoChi and Jikiden Reiki, along with Mesoamerican ceremonial practice learned from teachers including Sergio Magaña and Rita Navarrete Perez.

She frames her work as decolonial spiritual liberation, paying attention to how social structures shape the inner life of the people she works with. Her one-to-one sessions, mostly held online, draw on energy work, flower essences, oracle cards, drum journeys, soul retrieval and cord-cutting ceremony, while limpia cleansings are given in person only. Through the MINKA Mystery School she runs small Zoom courses for practitioners on Reiki, intuition and rethinking how healing work is taught, and at Kripalu she leads seasonal ceremonial retreats with Fumiha Tanaka and teaches for the centre's online studio.

courses.title: Moving From Shadow into Light: A Winter Solstice Journey
courses.description: A four-day ceremonial retreat at Kripalu over the winter solstice, co-led with Fumiha Tanaka. The group works through ritual, breathwork, plant lore and soul retrieval, drawing on Toltec teaching from central Mexico, to move from the dark of the year towards new intentions.

courses.title: Earth Evolution Reiki Certification
courses.description: A three-evening Zoom training, co-taught with Manu Del Prete, in the Earth Evolution Reiki symbol and practice the two teachers developed. Students need an earlier Reiki certification to join, and attunements are given by both teachers together.

courses.title: Spiritual Alignment for Healers: A Decolonizing Guide to Become a Better Healing Vessel
courses.description: A three-day online course for Reiki and other energy practitioners, taught with Manu Del Prete. It looks at how patriarchal and colonial framing has shaped the way energy work is taught, and how practitioners can reshape their own practice. A sliding scale is offered to BIPOC students.

courses.title: Spiritual Counseling and Coaching Sessions
courses.description: Private sessions that begin with a consultation and can combine Reiki and other energy work, flower essences, oracle readings, drum journeys, soul retrieval and cord cutting. Most take place online; limpia cleansing is offered in person only.
